hardware: Apple M4 Pro, 64 GiB RAM; original 14-worker SRG(29,14,6,7) quest active concurrently
policy: Full exact keys retained permanently for this solve. No eviction, truncation, or hash-only identity. No owner tokens.
representation: One bytearray table per (rows built, key byte length), each slot occupancy byte plus full key. Linear probing; resize at two-thirds load. Hash collisions compared byte for byte.

synthetic_memory.note: Separate processes; includes interpreter/imports. Baseline shares ownership tuples, conservatively understating production overhead. Live quest memory impact unmeasured.

timing_limits: Single samples; CPU includes parent plus reaped child processes. Small benchmarks show roughly similar solver times, not a proven speedup. Packed local operations are slower; manager IPC and solving dominate these runs.
